profile.headline: Software Engineer | MongoDB | Express.js | React.js | Node.js
profile.summary: Eric Jakobsen is a resilient and successful serial entrepreneur with over two decades of experience in e-commerce, software development, people management, and theatrical production. This varied background gives him the ability to see opportunities from multiple angles to make the best use of them. Eric leads with empathy and seeks to infuse all he does with good-natured humor and the belief that every person contains greatness.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of developers to build modern and responsive web applications using best practices. 

Built semantically structured and accessible full stack web applications. 

Applied agile methodologies like SCRUM for project management. 

Technologies Used: React, Express, MongoDB, NodeJS, JavaScript, CSS, SASS, Tailwind, Handlebars, JQuery, REST API's, Postman
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · React.js · Node.js · MongoDB

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
Created fully responsive websites and web applications that helped small businesses scale and increase market share by up to 50%.

Optimized sites for SEO and accessibility to increase Google and other search rankings by average of half a page. 

Trained clients in social media strategies to increase brand awareness and engagement.

Technologies Used: React, Express, MongoDB, NodeJS, JavaScript, CSS, SASS, Tailwind, Handlebars, JQuery, REST API's, Postman
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · React.js · Accessibility · Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

positions.title: Director Of Operations
positions.description:
Founded and scaled original e-commerce brand to over $1 million in sales across multiple e-commerce platforms. 

Oversaw production, branding, and fulfillment for thousands of quality consumer products. Maintained 99% customer satisfaction rating as measured by customer rating and feedback metrics. 

Implemented effective marketing strategies within both e-commerce and social media platforms that significantly increased sales while promoting positive brand awareness.
positions.insights: Skills: Operations Management · Project Management · Social Media Advertising · E-Commerce · SEO Copywriting

positions.title: Service Manager
positions.description:
Led a team of technicians and oversaw 100+ accounts accounts across greater Austin. Grew team by 30% and increased accounts by 20% during my tenure.

Designed and implemented new systems for regulating inventory and enhancing inter-level communication. Trained new hires and provided continuing education for current employees.  Revised and updated employee handbook and code of conduct.

Pushed expansion into lucrative holiday decor market that created annual increase of 200% client base. Collaborated on  proposals and designs for dozens of clients. Assisted with hiring and firing.
positions.insights: Skills: Employee Handbooks · Proposal Writing · Account Management · Supervisory Skills · Team Management

positions.title: Front End Specialist
positions.description:
Member of founding team that created Orlando's first combination organic cafe & tea shop which served over a million customers during its ten year run. 

Modeled excellent guest engagement to provide an environment where every person who entered felt seen and special. Increased loose leaf tea sales (highest profit margin category) by 300% within the first two years. 

Trained and managed front-end employees to emphasize product knowledge and unique specialty offerings. Designed and implemented original front end procedures, handbook, and code of conduct to prioritize boutique experience, and maximize profit and efficiency.

positions.title: Arts Administration Intern
positions.description:
Served on administrative team that developed and transitioned into new multi-million dollar facilities. 

Created quarterly course catalogs and maintained donor, student, and teacher databases. Edited national grant applications.

Served as liaison between teaching artists and administration. Represented the Center at cultural events across the city.
